# Amazon

> > Amazon's Whole Foods Market offers organic groceries, prepared foods, and exclusive Prime member deals with delivery and catering services.

Amazon operates Whole Foods Market as its premium grocery brand, featuring organic and natural products, weekly sales, and integrated Prime membership benefits. The site showcases featured brands like Siete, Fishwife, Carbone, and Whole Foods Market Kitchens alongside grocery delivery and prepared food services.

- Amazon Prime
